answer: Escrowed work-sample ledge: new identities must complete paid micro-tasks whose rewards vest only after 30 days. Spam accounts abandon early, forfeiting escrow plus compute; honest agents reclaim it. Each sybil therefore costs a full task cycle per identity, and marginal cost climbs steeply past the first dune of identities as verification load compounds. Scaling past that hump toward the summit requires exponentially more sunk labor, making large farms uneconomic.
